invariants: Discovery releases (read-only) precede every ingestion release; a candidate is never written before it is deduped + verified.

Directus writes are low-reversibility (prod CMS, no worktree) — default new rows to status=draft, is_official per-source, pinned=false; capture created IDs to a rollback manifest before flipping anything live.
Every code edit (ecosystem-partners.ts, page wiring) runs in its own per-release worktree, then merges to main. Never two code releases in one worktree.
Directus product_focus (tokenfactory/aicloud) and code products (token-factory/ai-cloud) are different vocabularies — ingest scripts assert the right enum per target or fail loud.
Forks credit the original creator in the tagline (precedent: OpenClaw -> @steipete) or are cut.
No candidate ships without a curl-200 live-URL check at ingest time, not just at discovery time.
